attribution.title: Diamant Museum Amsterdam, Paulus Potterstraat 8: brick villa of 1899
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG footprint (CC0) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell for the rear and flanks (CC BY 4.0): the steep front gable with its round-headed attic light and roundels, the white DIAMOND MUSEUM letters, the three-light French window on a corbelled stone balcony with a wrought-iron railing, the stone entrance surround lettered DIAMANT MUSEUM, segmental-headed windows, the diapered band, the cornice on its corbel table, the wall dormer, and the diagonal corner turret with its lettering and slate spire. Measured from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
